name: Merrick Sinclair
description: Rick's son, Jamie's younger brother. JD's first real friendship — later revealed to have begun partly out of pity. Recurring friction throughout: Liz (2015), Zenna (2016), and most significantly, his eventual relationship with Danielle. JD holds genuine distaste for his operating style while acknowledging the complexity. Cordial but carefully distanced in 2026.
bio: Rick Sinclair's younger son. JD's first modeled friendship. Initially friends with JD partly out of pity; JD worked to graduate from that category. In 2015, involved in a secret relationship with Liz Wangerin that JD observed as a procedural model for covert romantic pursuit. Later became involved with Danielle Vetere — which was one of the harder things JD processed through the Josh meetings. He and Danielle are now married.
